conventions.action: replace = replace currentAfterStep0 (exact text, first occurrence in lines lineAfterStep0..lineAfterStep0+n-1, n = its line count; every occurrence when replaceAll, expectedCount says how many) with target. insert = put target (complete line(s), indentation included) after the last line of anchor; anchor = currentAfterStep0, exact text starting at lineAfterStep0; selector names the rule (or the new rule). delete = remove the n lines starting at lineAfterStep0; currentAfterStep0 is their exact full text. skip = do not apply, see skipReason. token-step = done by step 0.
conventions.order: files in applyGroup order; edits inside a file bottom-up (descending line, an insert before any other edit on its anchor line), so each lineAfterStep0 stays valid while you work down the list and no anchor is changed by an earlier edit. Apply in the listed order.
conventions.lines: line / lineEnd / insertAfterLine = baseline 0d9bdd4; lineAfterStep0 = after step 0 (differs only in src/styles/global.css below the deleted block: -5).
conventions.doneByStep0: true = step 0 already produces the target; nothing to do (apply.py reports already-done).
conventions.targetToken: the rebrand token the target renders. In files that cannot read the token CSS (index.html boot splash, the CreditIncreaseIntro iframe material, SVG strings in TS) the target is that token's literal value.
conventions.visual: false = same rendered value, only points an undefined token at a defined one (hygiene), or a test assertion
conventions.needsOwner: true = value chosen but the owner must confirm (see conflicts.md); apply.py --skip-owner-items leaves them out
conventions.confidence: design = a visual-changes row says so; inferred = rule applied by analogy
conventions.fallbacks: var(--token, fallback) fallbacks of DEFINED tokens never render and are not listed; tools/apply.py --step 8 removes them after the motion patch (README "Step 8")
conventions.decided: "2026-11-24 <letter>" = the design owner answered this on 2026-11-24 (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md, "Decided 2026-11-24"); needsOwner is then false
conventions.structural: "owner-approved" = a small structural change (markup / state hook) the owner approved on 2026-11-24 (E023 + E542 tab icon, E543 + E400 overdue button); everything else stays purely visual

meta.precedence: changes-by-file.json > 01-tokens/token-map.json > 01-tokens/unresolved.md. Where an edit and the token map touch the same line, the edit wins: it runs after step 0 and anchors on the renamed text.
